1.web: The two angels came to Sodom at evening. Lot sat in the gate of Sodom. Lot saw them, and rose up to meet them. He bowed himself with his face to the earth,
1.asv: And the two angels came to Sodom at even; and Lot sat in the gate of Sodom: and Lot saw them, and rose up to meet them; and he bowed himself with his face to the earth;

2.web: and he said, “See now, my lords, please turn aside into your servant’s house, stay all night, wash your feet, and you can rise up early, and go on your way.” They said, “No, but we will stay in the street all night.”
2.asv: and he said, Behold now, my lords, turn aside, I pray you, into your servant’s house, and tarry all night, and wash your feet, and ye shall rise up early, and go on your way. And they said, Nay; but we will abide in the street all night.

3.web: He urged them greatly, and they came in with him, and entered into his house. He made them a feast, and baked unleavened bread, and they ate.
3.asv: And he urged them greatly; and they turned in unto him, and entered into his house; and he made them a feast, and did bake unleavened bread, and they did eat.

4.web: But before they lay down, the men of the city, the men of Sodom, surrounded the house, both young and old, all the people from every quarter.
4.asv: But before they lay down, the men of the city, even the men of Sodom, compassed the house round, both young and old, all the people from every quarter;

5.web: They called to Lot, and said to him, “Where are the men who came in to you this night? Bring them out to us, that we may have sex with them.”
5.asv: and they called unto Lot, and said unto him, Where are the men that came in to thee this night? bring them out unto us, that we may know them.

6.web: Lot went out to them to the door, and shut the door after him.
6.asv: And Lot went out unto them to the door, and shut the door after him.

7.web: He said, “Please, my brothers, don’t act so wickedly.
7.asv: And he said, I pray you, my brethren, do not so wickedly.

8.web: See now, I have two virgin daughters. Please let me bring them out to you, and you may do to them what seems good to you. Only don’t do anything to these men, because they have come under the shadow of my roof.”
8.asv: Behold now, I have two daughters that have not known man; let me, I pray you, bring them out unto you, and do ye to them as is good in your eyes: only unto these men do nothing, forasmuch as they are come under the shadow of my roof.

9.web: They said, “Stand back!” Then they said, “This one fellow came in to live as a foreigner, and he appoints himself a judge. Now will we deal worse with you, than with them!” They pressed hard on the man Lot, and drew near to break the door.
9.asv: And they said, Stand back. And they said, This one fellow came in to sojourn, and he will needs be a judge: now will we deal worse with thee, than with them. And they pressed sore upon the man, even Lot, and drew near to break the door.

10.web: But the men reached out their hand, and brought Lot into the house to them, and shut the door.
10.asv: But the men put forth their hand, and brought Lot into the house to them, and shut to the door.

11.web: They struck the men who were at the door of the house with blindness, both small and great, so that they wearied themselves to find the door.
11.asv: And they smote the men that were at the door of the house with blindness, both small and great, so that they wearied themselves to find the door.

12.web: The men said to Lot, “Do you have anybody else here? Sons-in-law, your sons, your daughters, and whoever you have in the city, bring them out of the place:
12.asv: And the men said unto Lot, Hast thou here any besides? son-in-law, and thy sons, and thy daughters, and whomsoever thou hast in the city, bring them out of the place:

13.web: for we will destroy this place, because the outcry against them has grown great before Yahweh that Yahweh has sent us to destroy it.”
13.asv: for we will destroy this place, because the cry of them is waxed great before Jehovah; and Jehovah hath sent us to destroy it.

14.web: Lot went out, and spoke to his sons-in-law, who were pledged to marry his daughters, and said, “Get up! Get out of this place, for Yahweh will destroy the city.” But he seemed to his sons-in-law to be joking.
14.asv: And Lot went out, and spake unto his sons-in-law, who married his daughters, and said, Up, get you out of this place; for Jehovah will destroy the city. But he seemed unto his sons-in-law as one that mocked.

15.web: When the morning came, then the angels hurried Lot, saying, “Get up! Take your wife, and your two daughters who are here, lest you be consumed in the iniquity of the city.”
15.asv: And when the morning arose, then the angels hastened Lot, saying, Arise, take thy wife, and thy two daughters that are here, lest thou be consumed in the iniquity of the city.

16.web: But he lingered; and the men grabbed his hand, his wife’s hand, and his two daughters’ hands, Yahweh being merciful to him; and they took him out, and set him outside of the city.
16.asv: But he lingered; and the men laid hold upon his hand, and upon the hand of his wife, and upon the hand of his two daughters, Jehovah being merciful unto him: and they brought him forth, and set him without the city.

17.web: It came to pass, when they had taken them out, that he said, “Escape for your life! Don’t look behind you, and don’t stay anywhere in the plain. Escape to the mountains, lest you be consumed!”
17.asv: And it came to pass, when they had brought them forth abroad, that he said, Escape for thy life; look not behind thee, neither stay thou in all the Plain; escape to the mountain, lest thou be consumed.

18.web: Lot said to them, “Oh, not so, my lord.
18.asv: And Lot said unto them, Oh, not so, my lord:

19.web: See now, your servant has found favor in your sight, and you have magnified your loving kindness, which you have shown to me in saving my life. I can’t escape to the mountain, lest evil overtake me, and I die.
19.asv: behold now, thy servant hath found favor in thy sight, and thou hast magnified thy lovingkindness, which thou hast showed unto me in saving my life; and I cannot escape to the mountain, lest evil overtake me, and I die:

20.web: See now, this city is near to flee to, and it is a little one. Oh let me escape there (isn’t it a little one?), and my soul will live.”
20.asv: behold now, this city is near to flee unto, and it is a little one. Oh let me escape thither (is it not a little one?), and my soul shall live.

21.web: He said to him, “Behold, I have granted your request concerning this thing also, that I will not overthrow the city of which you have spoken.
21.asv: And he said unto him, See, I have accepted thee concerning this thing also, that I will not overthrow the city of which thou hast spoken.

22.web: Hurry, escape there, for I can’t do anything until you get there.” Therefore the name of the city was called Zoar.
22.asv: Haste thee, escape thither; for I cannot do anything till thou be come thither. Therefore the name of the city was called Zoar.

23.web: The sun had risen on the earth when Lot came to Zoar.
23.asv: The sun was risen upon the earth when Lot came unto Zoar.

24.web: Then Yahweh rained on Sodom and on Gomorrah sulfur and fire from Yahweh out of the sky.
24.asv: Then Jehovah rained upon Sodom and upon Gomorrah brimstone and fire from Jehovah out of heaven;

25.web: He overthrew those cities, all the plain, all the inhabitants of the cities, and that which grew on the ground.
25.asv: and he overthrew those cities, and all the Plain, and all the inhabitants of the cities, and that which grew upon the ground.

26.web: But his wife looked back from behind him, and she became a pillar of salt.
26.asv: But his wife looked back from behind him, and she became a pillar of salt.

27.web: Abraham got up early in the morning to the place where he had stood before Yahweh.
27.asv: And Abraham gat up early in the morning to the place where he had stood before Jehovah:

28.web: He looked toward Sodom and Gomorrah, and toward all the land of the plain, and looked, and saw that the smoke of the land went up as the smoke of a furnace.
28.asv: and he looked toward Sodom and Gomorrah, and toward all the land of the Plain, and beheld, and, lo, the smoke of the land went up as the smoke of a furnace.

29.web: When God destroyed the cities of the plain, God remembered Abraham, and sent Lot out of the middle of the overthrow, when he overthrew the cities in which Lot lived.
29.asv: And it came to pass, when God destroyed the cities of the Plain, that God remembered Abraham, and sent Lot out of the midst of the overthrow, when he overthrew the cities in which Lot dwelt.

30.web: Lot went up out of Zoar, and lived in the mountain, and his two daughters with him; for he was afraid to live in Zoar. He lived in a cave with his two daughters.
30.asv: And Lot went up out of Zoar, and dwelt in the mountain, and his two daughters with him; for he feared to dwell in Zoar: and he dwelt in a cave, he and his two daughters.

31.web: The firstborn said to the younger, “Our father is old, and there is not a man in the earth to come in to us in the way of all the earth.
31.asv: And the first-born said unto the younger, Our father is old, and there is not a man in the earth to come in unto us after the manner of all the earth:

32.web: Come, let’s make our father drink wine, and we will lie with him, that we may preserve our father’s seed.”
32.asv: come, let us make our father drink wine, and we will lie with him, that we may preserve seed of our father.

33.web: They made their father drink wine that night: and the firstborn went in, and lay with her father. He didn’t know when she lay down, nor when she arose.
33.asv: And they made their father drink wine that night: and the first-born went in, and lay with her father; and he knew not when she lay down, nor when she arose.

34.web: It came to pass on the next day, that the firstborn said to the younger, “Behold, I lay last night with my father. Let us make him drink wine again, tonight. You go in, and lie with him, that we may preserve our father’s seed.”
34.asv: And it came to pass on the morrow, that the first-born said unto the younger, Behold, I lay yesternight with my father: let us make him drink wine this night also; and go thou in, and lie with him, that we may preserve seed of our father.

35.web: They made their father drink wine that night also. The younger went and lay with him. He didn’t know when she lay down, nor when she got up.
35.asv: And they made their father drink wine that night also: and the younger arose, and lay with him; and he knew not when she lay down, nor when she arose.

36.web: Thus both of Lot’s daughters were with child by their father.
36.asv: Thus were both the daughters of Lot with child by their father.

37.web: The firstborn bore a son, and named him Moab. He is the father of the Moabites to this day.
37.asv: And the first-born bare a son, and called his name Moab: the same is the father of the Moabites unto this day.

38.web: The younger also bore a son, and called his name Ben Ammi. He is the father of the children of Ammon to this day.
38.asv: And the younger, she also bare a son, and called his name Ben-ammi: the same is the father of the children of Ammon unto this day.
